meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo AI Video Materials
meta.description: Batch generate subtitle-free, voiceover-free short video material clips for MoneyPrinterTurbo.
meta.inputSummary: Scene description, aspect ratio, and scene number

steps.instruction: Generate standalone video clips that can be edited into a short video. Do not add subtitles, text, titles, watermarks, logos, or voiceover audio. Keep the subject and camera movement natural and avoid sudden cuts.

instructions: Each row generates one standalone MP4 video clip.
The scene number keeps multiple clips for the same topic visually distinct.

fields.label: Scene Description
fields.description: The visual, subject, action, and camera requirements for the clip to generate

presentation.placeholder: e.g. an office worker using an AI assistant, natural light, slow push-in

fields.label: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio of the final MoneyPrinterTurbo video

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.description: The scene sequence starting from 1 within the same batch

values.scenePrompt: an office worker using an AI assistant, natural light, slow push-in, no text and no watermark
